chapters: Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oidha' tas gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan tattat.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ja'p tattat jix maa jiiñak dharka' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' tomaat gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam buimɨi; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tattat duukat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ duaka' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tattat gu Por guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim suulh gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buimɨi jix duu bɨɨx no'ch.

Jano' ba' maakob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sebat oidha' tas gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan kavaayo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim suulhgia' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim suulhgia'.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' duuñ bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jerusalem gu Sioon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na gu' tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' cham bhai'.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem bɨɨx tu jiim; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' duuñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xoi'kam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh a'aa'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim suulhgia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Israeel gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios maakobh tu jiim.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jupaabkamu'n suulhgia' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix aa' bham; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mo'o; gu' suulhgia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam a'aa' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu oidha' gu Judaa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mi' dhɨr gu vupui guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu novɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm busaak mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam nobii'ñ jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu ñi'ook dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bham; mi' dhɨr cham vaak jodai ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem kuiñcha guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sioon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ bhaan ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Judaa gu maa'nkar gu oidha' abhaar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ abhaar gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Mostroome gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sataan ka't gu novɨ jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Sataan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jerusalem tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tɨi'chu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mi'p vupui bhaan bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ uañi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na jix bhai' bhaan mo'o; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Josuee bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tu' nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gio tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gio tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ɨrban.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam gu Pimpollo.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu jodai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Josuee; gio ba' bhaan dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu jodai cham tu'x jai'ch kɨɨv gu vupui; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ uañi'ñ gu oidha' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ maa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga duiñchu' bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨtaa'n iigɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbioo nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mɨichdhai bɨx jix uam jodai bɨɨx vaaso bhaan mo'o kɨɨv tɨtɨɨya tu jiim mɨichdhai; jano' ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' tɨtɨɨya tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu vaaso o'nsop.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sorobabeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' bɨɨx gu kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' chɨkka jix duu tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Sorobabeel ka' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Grakia nɨidhidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham.

Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Sorobabeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu vaak gu noobh gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook ka't na gu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Basaan na gu' jix kavɨk gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bipia'dam na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jordaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kakneer guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham ko'kmarak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chɨtda; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' tu' bipia'dam ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' kapbhai' gu chichio'ñ gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' tu' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maachim bia' kakneer; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Suabidad gu Ataduras; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kooda' vaik bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gio gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na vaak jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chuukug guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Suabidad guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bia' kakneer guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tɨtda:―Cha'pim; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim u'uuk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ataduras na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bipia'dam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bipia'dam gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chuukug guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham bhai' ka't bipia'dam cham tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaakax; gio ba' gu kuchii bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu; mi' dhɨr bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios muuk gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' duñiaꞌ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaaso guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu jodai guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx kavaayo bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim; gu' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa bhi'spio'kai gu vupui bɨx kavaayo gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Judaa na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu u'u na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem ka't tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai' gu Jerusalem.

Na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios vaak zel gu Judaa maa'n na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu vaak gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't na ja'p gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Dabii na ja'p daada' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu vaak gu Dabii bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ nɨidhidha' soi'm; gio ba' tu jiim tu' bhaan jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jerusalem na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Adadrimoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Megiddo.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Nataan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Lebii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simei guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kupi'ook na ba' gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem na ba' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ aajim chɨ'ñchoka'; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim gu oidha' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu taat gu naan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' cham ii'mdagaram na gu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu taat gu naan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha'; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ dɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii bhaan bipia'dam bhaan gu chio'ñ duiñchu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bipia'dam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kakneer; gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix uam jodai; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' kiicham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't gu vaak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan gu kavɨk gu Olibas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jerusalem baasɨ'n tas buusñi; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Olibas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tas buusñi bhaan tas gei'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu kakkavɨk; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm gu asal; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gi'ndukɨ gu tanoolh gu Ussiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tasi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa'; gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu xumai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gio mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't maa'n gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm gu Rimmoon saagi'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix daa tu' pai' dɨr ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin bɨɨx ka'm pai' ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu chuukug guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kua' bhaan tɨɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ nɨɨn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chin.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'n gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu novɨ duiñchu'.

Jano' ba' gu Judaa gio guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios namkɨm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp xikoolh; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu jiim na ja'p dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix ai buur guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chɨbɨɨp tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kabañas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham ɨlhdham bhaan dhuuk.

Jano' ba' tu' ja'tkam vaak gu Ejipto cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham daraibu' bhaan cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhuuk; gio ba' ɨlhdham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix duu chɨbɨɨp cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kabañas.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam uañi'ñ gu Ejipto uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kabañas.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan aajim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Kananeo oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
